name: Everflow Affiliate
shortInfo: Track affiliate marketers management, attribution, and Analytics, etc.
brief: Everflow is a performance marketing platform designed to help advertisers, affiliate marketers, and businesses partnering manage their marketing data efficiently.
about:
Get access to Raw conversions and reporting data through this Everflow Affiliate connector. It enables streaming of relevant Everflow Affiliate data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about api documentation [here](https://developers.everflow.io/docs/affiliate/).
availableData:
[**Raw Conversions**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/everflow-affiliate/pipelines/raw-conversions.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reporting metrics from the Everflow platform.

[**Reporting Data**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/everflow-affiliate/pipelines/reporting-data.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve unaggregated conversion data where each conversion is a “row” of data.
